rows.label: Kokoro 雲希
limits: 只能念中文（大陸口音）：數字 OK；整句英文改用 macOS Samantha 念，中文句子裡的英文字母（如 CNC）會被跳過。

rows.label: MediaTek VITS
limits: 只會念中文字：數字先轉成國字再念，整句英文改用 macOS Samantha，中文句子裡的英文字母（如 CNC）會被跳過；咬字較不清楚、每次念的長度不一（回聽錯字率約 10%，測試台詞約 14%），短句常吞字，不適合當測試講者。

Chinese characters only: numbers are spelled out first, English sentences go to macOS Samantha, Latin letters inside Chinese (e.g. CNC) are skipped; less clear and uneven (about 10% round-trip errors, 14% on the test lines), drops syllables of short lines, not a good test speaker.

rows.label: Qwen3-TTS Vivian
limits: 中英文都能念（官方支援 10 種語言），數字、中英夾雜 OK；繁體字會走音，所以先轉簡體再念；每句約 1.2–1.7 秒才開口，即時對話稍慢（改成邊合成邊播可解決）。

Chinese and English (10 languages), numbers and mixed text are fine; Traditional characters are mispronounced, so it reads Simplified; about 1.2-1.7 s before each sentence, a little slow to talk live (streaming playback would fix it).
